messages:
sana: Quick FYI 026 renewal invoice for NimbusCo (INV-2026-7789) shows a -$82,400 'platform fee credit' line. I did not approve a credit; expected a pro-rata true-up charge.
emily: Can you confirm the contract effective dates?
sana: Renewal effective 2026-04-01. Customer signed an amendment that backdated to 2026-03-01 reducing committed GPUs. Legal okayed backdate.
olga: tagging billing-bot to check import/true-up logic.
billing-bot: matched event CONTRACT_AMEND_6621. System computed PRO_RATA_PLATFORM_DELTA but applied negative sign. Root cause likely amendment-import sign inversion.
tom: Negative net invoice will hit revenue recognition and confuse customer communications. We need reversal + corrected invoice. Approving finance ops to proceed.
emily: Pulling invoice lines now: ```INV-2026-7789:
- PLATFORM_FEE_MONTHLY: $36,000
- SUPPORT_TIER_PREMIUM: $4,200
- PLATFORM_FEE_ADJUSTMENT: -$82,400
- NET_DUE: -$42,200```
Sana: The adjustment equals prior period prorata and should be a positive charge.
olga: I'll create BillingOps ticket BILL-7420 to reverse and reissue. Will include audit trail and journal entries for RevOps. ETA EOD.
emily: I'll open ENG ticket ENG-BILL-423 to add a unit test preventing delta-sign flips on import.
billing-bot: tasks created: BILL-7420, ENG-BILL-423.
tom: Good. Sana, please draft the customer note apologizing for the error and stating a corrected invoice will follow. If they dispute, escalate to me.
sana: Draft ready, will post in #customer-success and send after reversal is queued. Updating thread when invoice reissued.
